title: The letters in the essence of the soul: how one level becomes another
overview:
The chapter explains the garments of thought, speech and action from their root: the letters. The soul is full of letters from the moment it comes into being, letters of thought and letters of speech, each on three levels, from a bare picture or voice, which an animal also has, up to analysis and ordered speech. Speech is really the higher of the two: we are called talking man.

Even before the simple will there are letters, and above, in the Essence, they come before the light itself. They are not the power to limit: they are the power to define anything, finite or infinite, what makes a thing a something. After the will comes into being they become its letters, and only through letters can one *mahus* pass into another: the will into its reason, into the love in the will, the intellect into emotion, the emotion into thought (the man nervous before a job interview), thought into speech. So there is a chain from the essence of the soul to the end of action, and above, from the Essence down to the snow outside; and the higher levels are more of a something, not less.

terms.gloss: letters; the powers in the soul, and above in the Essence, to define anything as a something
vessels; the letters, whose root is higher than the light itself
the simple matter of every letter: the voice before the letters are cut, the highest level up there
the breath of the spirit of speech: the wind pushed out when one wants to talk
the cutting of the letters: each letter by itself, the second level of speech
the power to limit; it too comes from the letters, which are not it
the power of the unlimited; a definition made by G-d, not G-d Himself
the true something, the absolute something; why G-d has letters
a movement; letters are the various movements of what one can do
passing thoughts; the thoughts that come up out of an emotion

sections.title: The soul is full of letters: thought and speech, each on three levels
sections.summary: The root of the letters is the essence of the soul, which has letters of thought and letters of speech from the moment it comes into being, each breaking out on three levels, from a picture or a bare voice up to analysis and ordered speech. Speech is really the higher of the two: man is the talking one.

phrases.he: (לח) והנה מעתה יש להבין דרך פרט יותר בענין הלבושין דמחשבה דבור ומעשה כו',
כמו שכתוב לבושין תקינת לון כו'
ולזה יש להקדים תחלה שרש ומקור לבחינת האותיות, ומה שלפעמים נקראו בשם כלים ולפעמים בשם לבושין כו'
ואחר כך יתבאר דרך פרט בבחינת רחל ולאה, ומלכות דתבונה ובינה, עד רום המעלות כו'
דהנה שרש אותיות הוא בעצם הנפש ממש, שהנפש מלאה אותיות כידוע,
והיינו מתחלת עצם התהוותה

blocks.text: Now the chapter explains the *levushim* (garments) of thought, speech and action: first the root of the *osios* (letters), and why they are called both *kelim* (vessels) and *levushim*; then Rachel and Leah. The root of the letters is in the essence of the soul *mamash*, higher than anything.

phrases.he: ובב' אופנים, באותיות המחשבה ואותיות הדבור
phrases.en: There is already in the soul *osios hamachshava* and *osios hadibur*.

phrases.he: דהיינו מיד שתתהווה עצם הנפש מיוחדים בה אותיות מחשבה
וכלולים בה בעצם, כמו שכלול תנועת החי בחי כו'
ויוצאים ובוקעים לגלוי מחשבה בג' מדריגות
דמיון וציור בלא אותיות כלל,
phrases.en: imagination of a picture without actual letters of speech

phrases.he: ואותיות פשוטים מבולבלים בלי צירוף וחיבור ענין דבר מה,
phrases.en: just letters of blabbering that are all mixed up

phrases.he: ואותיות מצורפים על פי מחשבה עיונית כו'
phrases.en: *osios* are made up into thought through the *machshava iyunis*, through an analysis of a subject

blocks.text: The soul has *osios hamachshava* and *osios hadibur* (letters of thought and of speech). The letters of thought are in its essence from its start, as movement is in a living thing, and break out on three levels: **imagination of a picture without actual letters of speech**, which an animal has too; **letters of blabbering that are all mixed up**; and letters put together by *machshava iyunis* (analytical thought).

phrases.he: וכך יש בעצם הנפש בחינת אותיות הדבור
phrases.en: the same thing, there's in *etzem hanefesh* also *osios hadibur*

phrases.he: שהרי נקראת נפש המדברת או רוח ממללא
phrases.en: we're called talking man

phrases.he: וכלולים בה בעצם, ויוצאים לגלוי כתנועת החי וכהאי גוונא
כדבור של המלאכים דכתיב וקרא זה אל זה כו'

blocks.text: The soul's essence has **also *osios hadibur***: it is the speaking soul. **We're called talking man**, not *Homo sapiens*, thinking man. These letters too come out like a living thing's movement, like the angels' speech, "one called to the other".

phrases.he: והוא גם כן בג' מדריגות:
phrases.en: *osios hadibur* is also in three levels

phrases.he: חומר פשוט של כל אות ואות, ונקרא הבל רוח הדבור
ואותיות א''ב ג''ד מיוחדים בלי צירוף
phrases.en: the actual *chitoch* or the letter itself, but not the combination of the letters

phrases.he: וחיבור האותיות,
phrases.en: then the *osios* in order in the speech

phrases.he: שנקרא צורה שבדבור ברוח ממללא
כמו ב' רוחות מספרות, וכדבור המלאכים וכו':

blocks.text: Speech too has three levels. First the *chomer pashut* (simple matter) of each letter, the *hevel ruach hadibur* (breath of the spirit of speech): the sound before letters, which already holds a *midda* (emotion).

blocks.title: The dog's voice
blocks.text: An animal has this level too, as it has imagination: a dog's voice tells you whether he is happy or sad.
The second is the *chitoch* (cutting) of each letter by itself, *alef*, *beis*, **but not the combination of the letters**; the third, the letters joined, the form of speech, like the angels' speech.

blocks.question: So these letters are already in the soul. But why two different kinds? Aren't the letters of speech just the letters of thought being revealed?
blocks.text: Wanting to think and wanting to talk are two things. Speech comes through thought; but look closer and you cannot think without talking. The letters of speech are higher: we are called talking man.

That is one of the whole reasons that Torah study has to be *davka* (specifically) by talking and not only by thinking: talking activates thinking. Speech has to come through thought, but speech is the higher of the two. And you see that when somebody cannot talk in letters, he cannot think in letters either.

sensitivity.reason: "When somebody can't talk in letters, he can't think in letters either" could be read as a claim about people who cannot speak.

blocks.text: So in a way the highest thing is what the *tinokos shel beis rabban* (small schoolchildren) do, saying *alef*, *beis*, *gimmel*. A listener offers the jumbled letters of baby talk; yes, but something comes even before that.
blocks.outOfPlace: Later in class 208 (w1844-2312), between his first reading of lines 18-19 and his rereading of them, he comes back to the three levels of speech in lines 14-15.

blocks.text: Before the jumbled letters there is just a voice, the shofar, which even an animal has. Upstairs is backwards: the plain voice, before the *chitoch*, is highest there, the *chomer pashut* all the letters come out of.
blocks.outOfPlace: Later in class 208 (w1844-2312), between his first reading of lines 18-19 and his rereading of them, he comes back to the three levels of speech in lines 14-15.

blocks.question: Then why does the text say the chomer pashut "of every single letter"?
blocks.text: It is not just a simple voice: in it is the *chomer pashut* of every letter; every letter you say has its voice.
blocks.outOfPlace: Later in class 208 (w1844-2312), between his first reading of lines 18-19 and his rereading of them, he comes back to the three levels of speech in lines 14-15.

blocks.question: But isn't the voice really the vowels, which are not the letter itself?
blocks.text: No, the vowels too are voice. The *hevel* is the letter's basic voice: someone voicing a letter because he wants to say something, as the shofar is a plain sound and yet a supplication; the wind not of breathing but of pushing out a letter. The *chitoch* is the second level.
blocks.outOfPlace: Later in class 208 (w1844-2312), between his first reading of lines 18-19 and his rereading of them, he comes back to the three levels of speech in lines 14-15.

sections.title: Letters before the will: the power to define anything
sections.summary: Even before the simple will there are letters in the essence of the soul, and above, in the Essence: not the power to limit, but the power to define anything, finite or infinite, which makes a thing what it is. After the will comes into being they become the will's own letters, its somethingness.

phrases.he: והנה גם טרם שמתהוה מקור לרצון פשוט ותענוג פשוט, כבר יש אותיות הכלולים בעצם הנפש
רק אחר התהוות הרצון יוצאים
phrases.en: then these letters go out and become lower letters

phrases.he: להיות בחינת גלוי לרצון,
phrases.en: then they become the *kelim* of the *ratzon*, and they reveal the *ratzon*

phrases.he: ונקראו אותיות דרצון
phrases.en: then they're not the *osios* of the *Atzmus* anymore, they're the *osios* of the *ratzon*

blocks.text: Even before the simple will and delight, before *Keser* (crown) of *Ein Sof* (the Infinite), letters are in the essence of the soul, higher than the *sefiros* (Divine attributes). After the will comes into being they reveal it, as letters of the will; but the will itself comes *davka* from letters, which say it is a will and not something else.
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.text: The letters are the soul's power to define. Above, it is in the essence of the *Ein Sof*: the letters, the *kelim*, have a higher root than the light, and even the *Or Ein Sof* (infinite light) came from a "Let there be light".
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.text: The infinite light came because the *Aibershter* (G-d) said He wanted it, and the *ratzon hapashut* (simple will) because He decided on a will; there need not be one. As far as He is concerned, there is just the *Aibershter*.
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.question: So what is there? How does He think?
blocks.text: He doesn't have to think; He is not like us. What the *Atzmus* (Essence) is we do not know, but He has letters: He can define anything. Even the *ratzon hapashut*, relative to Him, is already a definition.
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.question: So these letters are the koach hagvul, the power to limit?
blocks.text: Not necessarily. Both the *koach hagvul* and the *koach habli gvul* (power of the unlimited), the *Or Ein Sof*, come from the letters: definitions He makes, not of Him. Some think the *koach habli gvul* is the *Aibershter*; it is not.
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.title: Rich and poor
blocks.text: So you say: how is unlimited a definition? It is *davka* not limited, as rich means not poor. A rich man also has $10, but not the limitation of $10; a poor man does. Must the infinite include the finite? I am finite and stuck with it; the Infinite, if He wants, can be finite, as the rich man can spend only $10. Not the other way: I can say I can fly if I want, but I can't.
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.text: So the letters are not the *koach hagvul*: they define a thing as finite or infinite, and more, make it what it is: His power to do anything He wants.
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.text: All He does is letters, the *tnuos* (movements) of what He can do, even a *tnua* of no *tnua*. Up there they are a total *hiyuli* (raw potential), not actual letters; in us they are already sort of letters.
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.text: In a sleeping person all the letters are there; everything that comes out, even raw emotion, comes in letters that were there already, the *chomer pashut*. It is almost as if this is what the *Aibershter* is: letters.
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.text: Reading the lines again: before the will, the letters are fixed in the soul's essence; after it, **these letters go out and become lower letters**, the *kelim* that reveal the will: **the *osios* of the *ratzon***.

phrases.he: שהוא בחינת גלוי הרצון ליש ודבר מה במציאת רצון,
שזהו עיקר ענין האותיות בעצם הנפש
שאינו רק בחינת גלוי אור עצם הנפש בכל איזה בחינת יש ומציאת דבר מה
phrases.en: any kind of revelation or something in a way of a *yesh* or an existence of something

phrases.he: על ידי האותיות
phrases.en: that will come later through the *osios*

phrases.he: יוצא בגלוי מבחינת היולי הנעלם כו'
(וכמו שכתוב בלקוטי אמרים בכ''ב אותיות שקבועים בנפש, שהן כ''ב כחות,
כ''ב תנועות הנפש כו')
phrases.en: It's 22 movements of the soul.

blocks.text: This is what letters are, **any kind of revelation or something in a way of a *yesh***, a something, coming out of their hidden *hiyuli* in the soul's essence: the somethingness of a thing.
He has letters too because He is the *yesh ha'amiti* (the true something), who can make any something; a letter is what you make somethings with.

blocks.title: Carving a toy
blocks.text: Carving wood into a toy is done with letters: the *tnuos* of the knife and the form pictured in the imagination. Anything is done with letters.
As *Likkutei Amarim* explains, the twenty-two letters fixed in the soul are twenty-two powers: **it's 22 movements of the soul**.

sections.title: Through letters the will passes from mahus to mahus
sections.summary: Without letters, which say what a thing is, its *mahus* (being), and that it is, its *metzius* (existence), the hidden will could never take on another garment: it is the will's letters that carry it into the reason for the will, and from there into the love in the will, down to the will for an action. All this is still within the will, in *Arich*.

phrases.he: ועל ידי זה יוכל הרצון לבא בגלוי באור השכל
ולולי התגלות הרצון בבחינת אותיות,
דהיינו מה שנראה למהות ומציאת רצון,
phrases.en: so that you know what this *ratzon* is, and what its *metzius* is

phrases.he: לא היה בא הרצון העצמי הנעלם בלבוש אחר ממהות למהות
phrases.en: It would not be able to come into a different *levush* and go from one *mahus* to another *mahus*.

phrases.he: שהוא בחינת הרצון הנראה ונגלה בשכל וטעם לרצון כידוע,
phrases.en: the rational of the *ratzon*

phrases.he: ודי למבין

blocks.text: The will needs letters before it to make it a will, and after it, **so that you know what this *ratzon* is**; otherwise the hidden will could not **go from one *mahus* to another *mahus***, from will to intellect.
That is the will revealed in its reason, the *chachma stima'a* (hidden wisdom) of *Arich*, **the rational of the *ratzon***: not yet actual intellect, only the intellect of the will.

phrases.he: וכך בשכל וטעם לרצון, שנקרא חכמה שברצון
מה שנראה למציאת טעם לרצון
הוא בחינת אותיות שבו
phrases.en: That's also *osios*.

phrases.he: על ידי זה יורד ממהות למהות המדות שברצון
phrases.en: It goes from this *mahus* of the *sechel* of the *ratzon* to this *mahus* of the *middos shebaratzon*.

phrases.he: כמו האהבה שברצון, שגם הוא אינו רק מציאת רצון,
phrases.en: it's also a *ratzon*

phrases.he: אלא שמלובש במהות אהבה,
phrases.en: it's enclosed in a *mahus* of love

phrases.he: שמצד הרצון הוא אוהב
phrases.en: because he wants this thing, he loves it

phrases.he: (אהבה לשון אבה, והה''א ה' חסדים המתפשטים מחכמה ובינה כו')

blocks.text: The reason for the will, its *chachma*, is also letters, by which **it goes from this *mahus* of the *sechel* of the *ratzon*** to the *middos shebaratzon* (emotions in the will). The love in the will is will **enclosed in a *mahus* of love**: **because he wants this thing, he loves it**.
*Ahava* (love) comes from *ava* (to want), and its *heh* is the five *chasadim* spreading from *chachma* and *bina*: they spread the original will into love.

phrases.he: ואותו הרצון עצמו הוא בשכל וטעם לרצון,
phrases.en: this same *ratzon* itself, which is higher than *sechel v'taam l'ratzon*, it is also still in the *sechel v'taam l'ratzon*

phrases.he: והוא עצם הרצון בהיותו עדיין למעלה מהשכל וטעם כו'
ואמנם על פי האותיות נשתנה ונראה בלמעלה מן השכל ובשכל ובמדות כו'
phrases.en: Through the *osios* it can change over from higher than *sechel* to *sechel* and to lower than *sechel*, into *middos*.

phrases.he: וכן יש אותיות למדות,
phrases.en: the same thing, the *middos* also have letters

phrases.he: שהוא מה שנראה האהבה שברצון במציאת יש כו'
עד הרצון שבמחשבה דבור ומעשה,
phrases.en: in other words, *Malchus* of the *ratzon*

phrases.he: לכולם יש בחינת אותיות,
עד אותיות הרצון שבמעשה
phrases.en: not the actual *maaseh*, the *ratzon* for the *maaseh*, which is the end of *Malchus* of *Arich*

phrases.he: כשהמעשה עולה ברצונו,
phrases.en: when the *maaseh* comes up in his *ratzon* that he wants to do such and such a thing

phrases.he: שיש לזה אותיות מיוחדים
phrases.en: It has special kind of letters.

blocks.text: The will itself, higher than its reason, is **also still in the *sechel v'taam l'ratzon***, as it is in the love and all the emotions; **through the *osios*** it changes from above intellect to intellect to *middos*.
**The *middos* also have letters**. All this is still in the will, in *Arich*, not yet *Atzilus*.

So on to *Malchus* of the will, the will for action: **not the actual *maaseh***, but **when the *maaseh* comes up in his *ratzon***. **It has special kind of letters**: all are letters of the will, of different kinds.

sections.title: Intellect into emotion, emotion into thought: the man waiting for a job interview
sections.summary: Below the will it is the same: the intellect becomes an emotion, a *hispaalus* (arousal), the emotion becomes thought and thought becomes speech only because each has letters of its own. The man nervous before a job interview shows it in both directions.

phrases.he: וכן על דרך זה בשכל שאחר הרצון
שאם לא היה השכל במציאת אותיות השכל, שהוא בחינת גלוי השכל במציאת, איך היה השכל בא בשינוי המהות בהתפעלות האהבה הנולד מצד השכל
phrases.en: If the *sechel* would not come into letters of its *metzius*, what it is, then how could there be *hispaalus* to actual *middos* to come from the *sechel*?

phrases.he: שגם שם הוא אותו השכל שהיה טרם שהוליד האהבה רק שנתלבש במהות אהבה כו'
אין זה רק על ידי האותיות שבו
phrases.en: That's only through the *osios*.

blocks.text: So too the intellect: **if the *sechel* would not come into letters**, how could *middos* come from it? Love is the same intellect dressed as love, *chesed* of *chesed* of the intellect: **that's only through the *osios*.**

phrases.he: וכן על דרך זה אותיות דמדות במחשבה
phrases.en: the letters of *middos* that come in *machshava*

phrases.he: אם לא היה המדה במציאת יש באותיות,
איך מתלבשת במהות מחשבה וכו',
phrases.en: How could it become enclothed in a thought about it?

phrases.he: וכן אותיות המחשבה בדבור כו'
phrases.en: the letters of thought when they get enclothed into letters of speech

blocks.text: So too **the letters of *middos* that come in *machshava***: if the emotion were not something in letters, **how could it become enclothed in a thought about it?**

blocks.title: Nervous before a job interview
blocks.text: A man waiting for a job interview thinks, "I'm really nervous." Nervousness is a *midda*; without letters he could not think it. And without letters there would be no *midda* at all: he is nervous because he is thinking about the interview.

blocks.title: Nervous before a job interview
blocks.text: The emotion came out of the intellect's analysis, in letters. He knows the employer, the job, what it pays, the swimming pool he can get his wife, his training, and the other well-trained guys who want the job. The *chachma* looks it over, the *bina* analyzes, *Malchus* of *tevuna* makes a thought, and from the thought comes the *midda*, which then goes up as *hirhurei liba* (thoughts of the heart).

blocks.title: Nervous before a job interview
blocks.text: Out of this *midda* come the *hirhurim*: he sits there thinking, "I wonder what they're going to ask me," which he could not if the *midda* had no letters. So too **the letters of thought when they get enclothed into letters of speech**.

sections.title: From the essence of the soul to the end of action, and the nimshal above
sections.summary: Through the letters there is a chain from the essence of the soul to the end of action, and above, from the letters in the Essence to this world, which is why the higher levels are more of a something, not less. The letters come into being with the essence itself, as one thing.

phrases.he: ונמצא על ידי האותיות יש בחינת השתלשלות עילה ועלול מעצם הנפש עד סוף מעשה,
phrases.en: So you see that the whole *hishtalshelus* from the *etzem hanefesh* to the *sof maaseh*

phrases.he: ושרש האותיות הוא בעצם הנפש ממש

blocks.text: So through the letters there is a *hishtalshelus* (chain of descent) of *ila v'alul* (cause and effect) from the soul's essence to the end of action. In the *nimshal* (what the analogy stands for), the whole world comes from the letters in the *Atzmus*: from *Ana Emloch* ("I shall rule") through the *reshimu* and the *Kav* to *Adam Kadmon*, *Atzilus*, *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*, the *mazalos* (constellations), all the way down here.

The snow outside, the walls, the earth pulling you down: all came down into a *metzius yesh* (an existing something). Without letters upstairs that are something, how could there be one here? Upstairs is not abstract: one letter, the *yud* of the Name, *chachma* of *Atzilus*, includes all these worlds.
blocks.outOfPlace: Tape 209 opens by carrying on with line 43 where tape 208 stopped, before he rereads the line at 209 w1235.

blocks.title: Rich and poor
blocks.text: So it is a bigger existence, like the rich man who also has $10. The whole world came out of that *yud*: there is more existence up there, not less, which is why, all the way up, it is the *yesh ha'amiti*, the absolute something.
blocks.outOfPlace: Tape 209 opens by carrying on with line 43 where tape 208 stopped, before he rereads the line at 209 w1235.

blocks.title: Nervous before a job interview
blocks.text: As the Rebbe says in the *Tanya*, a thought from an emotion is like nothing next to the emotion. The nervous *hirhurim* are nothing next to the nervousness, that next to his brain with its reasons, and that next to his will: the job, his wife, the pool, the kids' college. It gets bigger going up.
blocks.outOfPlace: Tape 209 opens by carrying on with line 43 where tape 208 stopped, before he rereads the line at 209 w1235.

blocks.title: Bill Gates and the tomatoes
blocks.text: The abstract is not less than the concrete; software shows it. Bill Gates's oodles of money came out of an abstraction; a tomato seller's tomatoes did not. A listener says every invention starts as an idea; but software, even produced, is letters. Or the Beatles' zillions from songs. He means the first spark of *chachma*: *hachachma techayeh ba'aleha*, wisdom gives life to its owners. You need a lot of tomatoes to make what one spark makes.
blocks.outOfPlace: Tape 209 opens by carrying on with line 43 where tape 208 stopped, before he rereads the line at 209 w1235.

blocks.title: Bill Gates and the tomatoes
blocks.text: Twenty supermarkets don't make money like Bill Gates's, or the Beatles' from maybe a hundred songs; Elvis is dead for years and they still make money on his. A store like the May Company, he thinks, has less than the Beatles made from a few songs.
blocks.outOfPlace: Tape 209 opens by carrying on with line 43 where tape 208 stopped, before he rereads the line at 209 w1235.

blocks.title: Bill Gates and the tomatoes
blocks.text: Even money is kept in abstract bank accounts; cash is no longer gold but paper with an idea on it, and $100 million is electronics, theoretical numbers. Today you *mamash* see that the abstract is not less than the concrete.
blocks.outOfPlace: Tape 209 opens by carrying on with line 43 where tape 208 stopped, before he rereads the line at 209 w1235.

blocks.text: Just the opposite: the main thing about an abstract idea is how much money you can make with it. As the Frierdiker Rebbe (the previous Rebbe) said, you see how crass and coarse the Americans are from what they ask: "What's he worth?" Not that he is worth something because he is a *talmid chacham* (a Torah scholar), a *tzaddik*, a *parush* (an ascetic), but "he's worth $100 million". Yet even the $100 million is an abstraction.
blocks.outOfPlace: Tape 209 opens by carrying on with line 43 where tape 208 stopped, before he rereads the line at 209 w1235.

sensitivity.reason: Calls Americans crass and coarse, quoting a saying of the Frierdiker Rebbe.

Not that he is worth something because he is a *talmid chacham* (a Torah scholar), a *tzaddik*, a *parush* (an ascetic), but "he's worth $100 million". Yet even the $100 million is an abstraction.

blocks.text: It can be in buildings but need not be; abstract property is still a something, and with it Bill Gates can buy buildings, horses, whatever he wants: a lot of tomatoes.

blocks.text: So the letters run as a chain of cause and effect from the soul's essence, or above, the *Atzmus*, to the end of action.

שמתהווים עם עצם אור הנפש כאחד
phrases.en: is *mamash* one thing. It is *etzem or hanefesh*.

phrases.he: כמו שמתהווה בחי כח התנועה עמו כו'
phrases.en: When a *chai* is *mis'haveh*, the *koach hatnua*, it's not like a separate thing that is added on, it's *mis'haveh imo*.

blocks.text: So the letters come into being with the light of the soul's essence: **is *mamash* one thing**, as a living thing's *koach hatnua* (power of movement) is **not like a separate thing that is added on**. The *Aibershter* is not full of letters: it is the same thing.

phrases.he: והנמשל מכל זה הרי מובן

בג' מדריגות הנזכר לעיל

הכל נמשך ויורד מזה לזה דרך עילה ועלול בשינוי מהות למהות על ידי בחינת האותיות של כל מהות שהוא בחינת גלוי היש שלו במציאת כנזכר לעיל
עד בחינת סוף מעשה דמלכות דאצילות, שהוא בחינת אותיות דמעשה דמלכות דאצילות, עד מלכות דמלכות דעשיה, שרש התהוות העולם השפל שלנו
(כמו שיתבאר בסוף הקונטרס)
phrases.en: like this will be explained later

phrases.he: שנכלל הכל במה שכתוב כל אשר חפץ יהו״ה בעצמותו ממש, עשה בפועל ממש, ודי למבין:

blocks.text: The *nimshal* follows: **the letters of *kaviyachol*** (so to speak) in the *tehiru ila'a* (upper space), **with letters, *glif glifu*** (He engraved an engraving), the essential letters of thought and speech in the *Atzmus Or Ein Sof*, like those in the soul's *yechida*, in the same three levels.

These letters **go down from one *mahus* to another**: from *Ana Emloch*, before the *tzimtzum*, through *Adam Kadmon*, *Atik*, *Arich*, *Abba* and *Ima*, *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva*, by cause and effect, down to *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*. All is in the verse: whatever G-d desired, in His very Essence, He did in actual deed.

reviewQuestions.question: What are the three levels of the letters of thought, and the three of the letters of speech? Which of them does an animal have?
Why does he say the letters of speech are higher than the letters of thought, and what follows for Torah study?
Why are the letters not the *koach hagvul*, and what does the rich man with $10 show about the infinite?
Without letters, why could the hidden will not pass into the reason for the will, or into the love in the will?
How does the man waiting for a job interview show letters going from intellect to emotion and from emotion to thought?
Why is there more existence up above than down here, not less?
